title: Systems Hub
subtitle: MCP servers and app testing, scoped to your systems (Project/Product) rather than to an agent -- see /mcp for per-agent MCP config.

catalog.title: MCP catalog
catalog.description: Register a server once, then assign it to any number of agents or projects -- including 'apply to all agents, including ones registered later'.

projectMcp.title: Project MCP servers
projectMcp.description: MCP servers scoped to a project's own working directory (Claude Code's .mcp.json today). Pick a project to manage its servers.

backgroundTests.title: Background app testing
backgroundTests.description: Ask an agent to test a product's live application, in the background or watched live, without blocking the chat.
backgroundTests.noRoutines: This product has no automation routines yet -- create one from the Web App pane's Automations panel first, then come back here to enable it for background testing.
